model: g2/evidence/g2-20261123-em9305-ram-80542c-28byte-paired-sims.json (grow one properly sized object; retire overlapping harvested objects; record object_count_before/after)
reason: Indexing past the 1-byte em9305_ram_80faec into em9305_ram_80fb08 as ((volatile uint32_t *)&em9305_ram_80faec)[index] is undefined behavior: it depends on link layout and the compiler is allowed to break it.

stock_user_pass.lock_table: stock 0x302d20 opencfw_em9305_sleep_lock_update uses 17 word slots index 0..16; slot 16 ends at 0x80fb2c; 0x80fb30 is the first word after the table, not a lock-table entry.

aliased_objects.em9305_ram_80fb08: 8-byte object at 0x80fb08 covering lock slots 7 and 8 (0x80fb08/0x80fb0c). Also the SPIM/boot record used by opencfw_em9305_stock_311ee0 (stores descriptor &em9305_ram_80fd2c+0xc at +4 / u32_80fb0c) and opencfw_em9305_stock_30ecf8 (writes +0=0x80ffa8, +40=0x10c3a8, passes &80fb08 to rom_boot_status). All observed accesses are 32-bit. Nothing uses these addresses at another width.
aliased_objects.em9305_ram_80fb30: Kept as its own typo-RAM object. It is boot record +40 and the controller timer word in controller_init.c (opencfw_em9305_controller_register_timer(em9305_ram_80fb30.u32_80fb30)). Not a lock-table entry.

object_count_note: Count is the number of header externs matching ld symbols. Retired em9305_ram_80fb08 from em9305_ram.h and g2-em9305.ld. Kept em9305_ram_80faec=0x0080faec and em9305_ram_80fb30=0x0080fb30. Header and ld symbol sets match at 145.
em9305_ram_80faec: 68-byte 17-word object: union of uint32_t u32[17] and named fields u32_80faec..u32_80fb2c, with u8 aliases on 80faec/80fb08/80fb0c. _Static_assert(sizeof==68); offsetof(u32_80fb08)==0x1c, offsetof(u32_80fb0c)==0x20, offsetof(u32_80fb2c)==0x40. Removed struct em9305_ram_80fb08.

source_fix.sleep_enter_mode.c: lock load is now uintptr_t object=em9305_ram_80faec.u32[index]; (no 1-byte object indexing)
